# Vendored libraries

- `uplot-1.6.32/`: uPlot 1.6.32 (MIT, `LICENSE` alongside), files `dist/uPlot.iife.min.js` and
  `dist/uPlot.min.css` from the npm package `uplot@1.6.32`. Vendored so the public page makes no
  third-party requests at runtime. To update, replace both files and the directory name, and the
  paths in `../index.html`.
